title: KU physicist Daniel Tapia Takaki named American Physical Society fellow
summary_en: Founded in 1899, the American Physical Society honors members with the designation of fellow for significant accomplishments in physics. Tapia Takaki was recommended for the honor by the society’s Division of Nuclear Physics.
title_cn: KU physicist Daniel Tapia Takaki named American Physical Society fellow

title: 2026 Gene A. Budig Lecture will explore teacher identity through multimodal writing
summary_en: Hyesun Cho, professor in the Department of Curriculum & Teaching, will present “Teacher Identity, Emotion, and Agency Through Multimodal Writing” at 4:30 p.m. Oct. 13 in Room 150 of Joseph R. Pearson Hall. A reception will begin at 4 p.m.
title_cn: 2026 Gene A. Budig Lecture will explore teacher identity through multimodal writing
